mapper.sql: j.id, j.title, j.department_id, j.employment_type, j.location, j.description, j.salary_min, j.salary_max, j.salary_currency, j.status, j.priority, j.recruiter_id, j.hiring_manager_id, j.deadline, j.published_at, j.created_at

WHERE j.is_deleted = FALSE AND j.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND (j.deadline IS NULL OR j.deadline >= #{today}) AND j.department_id = #{departmentId} AND j.location = #{location} AND j.employment_type = #{employmentType}
AND (LOWER(j.title) LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '\' OR LOWER(j.description) LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '\' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job_skills js JOIN skills s ON s.id = js.skill_id WHERE js.job_id = j.id AND LOWER(s.skill_name) LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '\'))
mapper.select: SELECT js.job_id, s.id AS skill_id, s.skill_name, s.category FROM job_skills js JOIN skills s ON s.id = js.skill_id WHERE js.job_id IN #{id} ORDER BY js.job_id, LOWER(s.skill_name)
SELECT DISTINCT j.department_id FROM jobs j WHERE j.is_deleted = FALSE AND j.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND j.department_id IS NOT NULL AND (j.deadline IS NULL OR j.deadline >= #{today})
SELECT DISTINCT j.location FROM jobs j WHERE j.is_deleted = FALSE AND j.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND j.location IS NOT NULL AND (j.deadline IS NULL OR j.deadline >= #{today}) ORDER BY j.location
SELECT j.id FROM jobs j WHERE j.is_deleted = FALSE AND (j.recruiter_id = #{userId} OR j.hiring_manager_id = #{userId})
